obernants.operator: Within supplied lawful scenes, excluded observations include a directional path absent from projected facts, reporting None when a nonempty path exists, returning Some(false) after a longer Far/fully-qualified witness is reachable, and treating the zero-edge x-to-x walk as a dir_path witness. At the caller, holds(x,r,x)=true and an object-fact answer overriding an earlier applicable block inference are excluded under the existing precedence.

obernants.operator: For a tagged query result retain all scenes, facts, object/block attributes and reachable product-state witnesses producing it. Some(true) from dir_path can arise from an explicit Far edge or a sufficiently long fully-qualified path; these witnesses are not uniquely recoverable. None constrains directional reachability, not unrelated facts. tv erases witness provenance and can merge different direct, block and inferred causes.

obernants.operator: The visited key is (object, far_seen, min(steps,2), all_edges_qualified). Merging visits by object alone loses distinctions needed for later witnesses. Qualification is conjoined along edges; far_seen is disjoined. State transitions use exact fact membership in either orientation for Near/Far/Touch qualification, and termination follows from the finite product-state space.

obernants.operator: E<=64 keeps the scan traversal. For larger E the outgoing preflight examines the requested start and relation before allocating indexed rows; absent outgoing edges return the operation's exact no-path result. Present starts pay index construction even if little else is reached. This dispatch is a resource policy over one relation, not a new inference rule.
